reference_sql:
WITH product_rev AS (  -- one row per quarter and product with sales in 2025
  SELECT quarter(order_date) AS qtr, category_name, product_id, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue
  FROM sales
  WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY quarter(order_date), category_name, product_id
),
ranked AS (  -- one row per quarter and product with sales in 2025
  SELECT qtr, category_name, product_id, revenue,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY qtr, category_name ORDER BY revenue DESC, product_id) AS rn
  FROM product_rev
)
SELECT qtr, category_name, product_id, revenue
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
alternatives:
SELECT t.qtr, t.category_name, t.product_id, t.revenue
FROM (
  -- one row per quarter and product with sales in 2025
  SELECT quarter(order_date) AS qtr, category_name, product_id, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY quarter(order_date), category_name ORDER BY SUM(net_revenue_eur) DESC, product_id) AS rn
  FROM sales
  WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY quarter(order_date), category_name, product_id
) AS t
WHERE t.rn = 1

WITH product_rev AS (  -- one row per quarter and product with sales in 2025
  SELECT quarter(order_date) AS qtr, category_name, product_id, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue
  FROM sales
  WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY quarter(order_date), category_name, product_id
)
SELECT pr.qtr, pr.category_name, pr.product_id, pr.revenue
FROM product_rev pr
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_rev pr2
                  WHERE pr2.qtr = pr.qtr AND pr2.category_name = pr.category_name
                    AND (pr2.revenue > pr.revenue OR (pr2.revenue = pr.revenue AND pr2.product_id < pr.product_id)))

FROM product_rev pr
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_rev pr2
                  WHERE pr2.qtr = pr.qtr AND pr2.category_name = pr.category_name
                    AND (pr2.revenue > pr.revenue OR (pr2.revenue = pr.revenue AND pr2.product_id < pr.product_id)))
other_way.tradeoff: NOT EXISTS keeps the product that no other beats in its category and quarter; it needs no window but repeats the tie-break by hand.

solver.query:
WITH p AS (SELECT quarter(order_date) AS qtr, category_name, product_id, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue FROM sales WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY 1, 2, 3),
r AS (SELECT qtr, category_name, product_id, revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY qtr, category_name ORDER BY revenue DESC, product_id) AS rn FROM p)
SELECT qtr, category_name, product_id, revenue FROM r WHERE rn = 1
